## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem, its trigger, and the resulting behavior after
this change. Link the relevant issue or explain the intended scope.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish interactive OS testing
from compilation and automated tests. State any relevant checks not run.
See [contributor setup](https://github.com/CharlieJamesGwapo/project-memory-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Compatibility and limits

Describe relevant tool/schema, saved-data, privacy, permission or platform
impacts. Link updated user documentation when behavior changes. Include known
limitations; avoid pasting private archives, credentials or saved project text.
